title: AE21 population-play pool (Classic)
note: Frozen evaluation pool for round-robin Elo. Top entry (tags.champion) is the latency-unbounded strength ceiling P13's shippable tiers are measured against; bump it whenever a won experiment raises the ceiling. mcts members use fixed iterations (not time budgets) so the pool is reproducible across machines. Run a subset with --members=a,b,c; the heavy mcts arm is a separate pooled run.
